content_html_sanitized:
Abdul-Jabbar Arrested At Canadian Border; Has 6 Grams Of Ganja;
Fined $500 Must Fill Out 4 Sets Of Customs Forms!

TORONTO

The Toronto Star reported today that Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, the NBA’s career leading scorer, was arrested by U.S. Customs officials Sunday for possession of six grams of marijuana at Pearson International Airport. Abdul-Jabbar, the former Los Angeles Lakers center was fined $500 and released without conditions, before being allowed to board a flight to Los Angeles. However, his name was entered into Canadian and U.S. police computers.

A U.S. Customs dog detected the marijuana, which the former Los Angeles Lakers center concealed in a glass vial.

After being arrested for possession of a "controlled drug," he was not charged by Canadian police, who used their discretionary powers to leave the matter with U.S. Customs. U.S. Customs spokesman Cherise Miles said any U.S. citizen caught with a small amount of marijuana is fined $500 and required to fill out four sets of Customs forms.
